vectors.description: xn--abc-, an xn-- label that decodes to ASCII only. Every such label ends with a hyphen, so the hyphen rule rejects it.
xn--, with nothing after the prefix. It ends with a hyphen.

An xn-- label that decodes to a string containing U+202E, a right-to-left override.
An xn-- label that decodes to pay, U+200B (a zero-width space) and pal, which displays as paypal.

An xn-- label that decodes to a, U+FF61 and b. The full stop displays like a dot, so the label would look like two labels.
